name: Tee
source:
The daughter of the Hawk Clan's Leader and the younger sister of Lugus.
She has a big ego and is a selfish girl who always looks down on people from above.
She falls in love with a certain man and sometimes shows a much more feminine side.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/psychedelica/aa-nisus/chara/?page=tee]official website[/url]]
